principle: Everything an operative can use is a plugin. Cells opt in; the Force does not ship a hidden toolbox.

plugins.title: Feishu Board
plugins.summary: Read and post to the shared IM board. Default on for every operative.

plugins.title: Files
plugins.summary: Read authorized workplace files, attachments, and cell notes.

plugins.title: Search
plugins.summary: Grep the workplace for symbols, routes, and config keys.

plugins.title: Shell
plugins.summary: Run commands inside the authorized workplace directory.

plugins.title: Web
plugins.summary: Fetch public documentation. No production credentials.

plugins.title: HTTP Observe
plugins.summary: Send in-scope HTTP requests and record status, headers, and body shape.

plugins.title: Evidence
plugins.summary: Record file, offset, request, and command evidence without secrets.

plugins.title: Diff
plugins.summary: Compare two files or two board revisions.

plugins.title: Report
plugins.summary: Format SRC findings: impact, preconditions, and fix notes.
